title-group.article-title: Raw versus pasteurized milk and gastrointestinal symptoms: a randomized crossover trial

license.license-p: This article is distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.

sec.title: Background
sec.p: Raw milk is claimed to be better tolerated than pasteurized milk.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: We randomized 120 adults with self-reported lactose intolerance to raw or pasteurized milk.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: Symptom scores did not differ between groups (mean difference 0.2, 95% CI -0.4 to 0.8).

abstract.p: Graphical abstract text that should be ignored.

sec.title: 2.2. Statistical analysis
sec.p: We used a linear mixed model with α = 0.05.

sec.title: 3. Results
sec.p: Of 120 randomized participants, 112 completed both periods.

sec.title: 4. Discussion
sec.p: Raw milk did not reduce symptoms.

sec.title: 4.1. Strengths and limitations
sec.p: Participants were not blinded to milk taste.

sec.title: 4.2. Comparison with other studies
sec.p: Our findings agree with earlier trials.

sec.title: 5. Conclusions
sec.p: Raw milk was not better tolerated than pasteurized milk.
